mapper.select: SELECT id, reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason, description, status, handler_id, handle_note, handled_at, created_at FROM report WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason, description, status, handle_note, created_at) VALUES (#{reporterId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{description}, 'PENDING', '', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_note = #{handleNote}, handled_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
